theorems.name: Submission.doragm_sab_deriv_weight_squeeze
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (N : Euclid P → ℝ) (A s τ : ℝ), 1 < A → 0 < s → s ≤ τ → (∀ u, deriv φ u ≤ 0) → (∀ u, deriv φ u ≠ 0 → 1 < u ∧ u < A) → (∀ x, 0 ≤ N x) → Integrable (fun x => -(‖x - y‖ / τ ^ 2) * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) * (N x / (max s ‖x - y‖) ^ n)) μ → Integrable (fun x => -(‖x - y‖ / τ ^ 2) * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) * N x) μ → 0 ≤ ∫ x, -(‖x - y‖ / τ ^ 2) * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) * N x ∂μ ∧ ∫ x, -(‖x - y‖ / τ ^ 2) * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) * (N x / (max s ‖x - y‖) ^ n) ∂μ ≤ (∫ x, -(‖x - y‖ / τ ^ 2) * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) * N x ∂μ) / τ ^ n ∧ (∫ x, -(‖x - y‖ / τ ^ 2) * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) * N x ∂μ) / τ ^ n ≤ A ^ n * ∫ x, -(‖x - y‖ / τ ^ 2) * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) * (N x / (max s ‖x - y‖) ^ n) ∂μ
